data_window: 2026-08-17 00:00 to 2026-08-20 11:14 Asia/Shanghai. GitHub Search API queries covered ai agent, mcp agent, browser agent, and codex agent with both created:>=2026-08-17 and sort=updated strategies. Raw responses were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_08_20_*.json; selected README audits were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_08_20_readmes/.
source_summary: git fetch origin succeeded on main; pre-existing unrelated frontend/deploy worktree changes and the untracked 2026-08-19 Lark retry note were preserved unstaged. Discovery used unauthenticated GitHub Search API metadata plus selected README audits through the GitHub API raw README endpoint. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, desktop-tested, mobile-tested, MCP-handshake-tested, credential-tested, provider-tested, payment-tested, security-scanned or deployed.
trend_observations: Today clustered around multi-agent control planes, local harness routing, MCP production hardening, local memory and durable long-horizon execution loops. The strongest projects expose real product surfaces such as desktop apps, CLI quickstarts, SDKs, MCP servers, release downloads, screenshots, dashboards, receipts, traces or protocol-level extensions. Thin prompt guides, SDK wrappers, profile repos and concept-only READMEs were downgraded.
assumptions: Scores are editorial point-in-time rankings based on GitHub Search API metadata, README evidence, visible product surface, install/build cues, documentation completeness, repository freshness and AI-native workflow depth. Stars and forks are snapshots from unauthenticated GitHub Search API, not exact growth deltas. README claims were not independently runtime-verified. Pure skill collections, generic lists, thin wrappers, paper/training repos and concept-only READMEs were downgraded or skipped.
